dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: You look tired. Need a break?

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: I tend to find that distracting the mind by focusing on something else is an excellent way to relax. We could chat about today's news stories, for instance.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Or anything else you'd like to talk about, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: I didn't realize quite how strong the enemies that you have to fight are...

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: If you've invited me here, it must be because you're confident that my skills will come in handy.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: So, no need to be coy, alright? I'm here to help however you need.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: I've always felt that a library full of books is just like a shelf full of perfumes.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: It's worth taking the time to study and appreciate each one, until you find the one that's perfect for you.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: That experience, of holding onto hope as you search for the one... It's a beautiful thing, worth treasuring.
